versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the error-message-improver skill.
- Provides a structured workflow for generating clearer error messages that include what failed, why it failed, and recommended next actions.
- Enables creation of reusable checklists, templates, or workflows for error message improvement.
- Designed for application developers, support teams, SaaS operators, and end-users seeking actionable feedback.
- Focused on local-hardware-friendly implementations, avoiding heavy cloud or large-model requirements.
- Includes clear validation steps to ensure outputs are actionable and assumptions are transparent.
